# Go callers may inspect partial AppendBinary output on error; loGo/s callers
# intentionally cannot read a non-error result on that path.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd consumer
logos run .
stdout '^rejected append ok$'
cd ../model
logos eject -o out
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/go.mod
cd ../consumer
cp go.ejected.mod go.mod
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
stdout '^rejected append ok$'

-- model/go.mod --
module example.com/rejectedmodel

go 1.27

-- model/model.lgo --
package rejectedmodel

type Empty struct{}

type Holder struct {
	Items []Empty `json:"items"`
}

type Fat struct {
	Scratch [4096]byte `json:"-"`
}

type FatHolder struct {
	Items []Fat `json:"items"`
}

-- consumer/go.mod --
module example.com/rejectedconsumer

go 1.27

require example.com/rejectedmodel v0.0.0

replace example.com/rejectedmodel => ../model

-- consumer/go.ejected.mod --
module example.com/rejectedconsumer

go 1.27

require example.com/rejectedmodel v0.0.0

require github.com/gosuda/loGos/rt v0.0.0 // indirect

replace example.com/rejectedmodel => ../model/out

replace github.com/gosuda/loGos/rt => ../model/out/_logos_deps/rt

-- consumer/main.go --
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"unsafe"

	"example.com/rejectedmodel"
)

func main() {
	check("count", rejectedmodel.Holder{Items: make([]rejectedmodel.Empty, 1048577)})
	check("storage", rejectedmodel.FatHolder{Items: make([]rejectedmodel.Fat, (8<<20)/int(unsafe.Sizeof(rejectedmodel.Fat{}))+1)})
	fmt.Println("rejected append ok")
}

func check(label string, value interface{ AppendBinary([]byte) ([]byte, error) }) {
	prefix := []byte{0xee, 0xdd}
	got, err := value.AppendBinary(append([]byte(nil), prefix...))
	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "out of range") {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: expected count-out-of-range error, got %v", label, err))
	}
	// The version is emitted before the rejected field; its count is not.
	want := []byte{0xee, 0xdd, 1}
	if !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: rejected append bytes %x, want %x (no count header)", label, got, want))
	}
}
